conclusion: Two independent readers checked the original article, individually inventoried supplements, exact vendor guides, author parser, cited Slide-seqV2 predecessor and publisher correction. Complete branch-specific junction and 15-printed-versus-14-parser barcode reconciliation remains open, so missing assertions stay blocked.
